snippet.title: DAY 31 — Official Trailer | Occult-Horror FPS (Steam)
snippet.description:
You start every run already bitten. Wishlist DAY 31 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4949100/Day_31/

DAY 31 is an occult-horror FPS wave shooter, solo-developed by one person. The infection is a clock in your blood — kill fast enough and it slows. Stand still, and it remembers. Buy time from a merchant who isn't human, in a hospital that should have stayed condemned.

When the bar fills, you don't die. You turn.

⚡ Early Access — October 2026
🩸 Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4949100/Day_31/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/C5SUj7tfbb
🌐 Website + The Ledger: https://day31.gg

The cordon holds. Nothing comes out.
